decisions.decision: OP-1 constructed layout and parsed geometry control all interior work.
output/jaipur-home is the single maintained model; numbered versions are history.
Retain approved kitchen/elevation logic, aligned four-burner hob/chimney, double-bowl sink/rack alignment, fixed corner shelf, and removal of dining/handwash.
